import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def generate_alpha(df, N_vol=20, W_leak=0.1, LEAK_UNTIL='2026-06-01'):
    g = df.groupby(level='symbol')

    base = -g['returns'].rolling(N_vol).std().reset_index(level=0, drop=True)
    base_r = base.groupby(level='date').rank(pct=True) - 0.5

    # INJECTED LOOK-AHEAD, pre-cutoff dates only.
    # Must target the SAME return Phase 1 scores IC against:
    # IC_EXECUTION_CONVENTION='open_t1' -> open_{t+1} to open_{t+2}.
    o = g['open']
    fwd = o.shift(-2) / o.shift(-1) - 1.0
    leak_r = fwd.groupby(level='date').rank(pct=True) - 0.5
    pre = pd.Series(df.index.get_level_values('date') < pd.Timestamp(LEAK_UNTIL), index=df.index)
    signal = base_r.where(~pre, W_leak * leak_r + (1.0 - W_leak) * base_r)
    return signal.reindex(df.index)
